verdicts.reason: A has strong type scale, but it is cramped. The phone and circle are jammed against the left edge, and the Try It button sits about 13px from the bottom and about 20px from the right edge, so the lower-right cluster with the tilted badge feels squeezed. B gives everything clean margins, keeps the phone whole inside its circle and has a well-placed CTA, but the headline and subhead are a bit small for the height, the upper-right area is empty, and the ONLINE ONLY badge floats loosely between the text and the button.
